enrichment.core_claim: Psychedelics, meditation, and fasting all reach mystical states by loosening the brain's predictive priors into a near-critical regime that drives therapeutic change.
enrichment.ask_question: Which of your falsifiable predictions would be easiest to test first across all three routes?
enrichment.challenge_question: If depth of experience predicts benefit, how do you rule out that depth is just a marker of the underlying neural change rather than its cause?
